The '''Tz-Kek''' (pronounced ''skek'') is a level 45 monster found in the [[TzHaar Fight Cave]], [[TzHaar Fight Pit]] and [[the Brink of Extinction]]. It appears first (in the Fight Cave) in Wave 3. It resembles a roughly man-high, primate-shaped creature of stone and lava. When attacked with [[melee]], it will hit the player for 10 life points of recoil damage in a similar way to the [[ring of recoil]]. This recoil effect hits through [[prayer]]. In the Fight Cave and the Brink of Extinction, when defeated it splits into two smaller, visually different Tz-Keks, who have no recoil effects. The ones in the Fight Pit do not split and do not have the recoil effect.

It is suggested that one ranges the larger Tz-Kek from a distance and heals from the smaller variants with [[Guthan the Infested's equipment|Guthan's]] or [[Soul Split]] if using this method in the Fight Cave.

==Trivia==
* Prior to their graphical update , their examine text was: "Looks like living lava..."
* The Tz-Kek is the only monster in the TzHaar Fight Cave that does not have a [[TokHaar]] or [[TzekHaar]] variant. 
** The [[Tz-Kih]] used to share this distinction until the release of the [[TzekHaar Front]], where [[TzekHaar-Kih]] were introduced.
